final: SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id, a.frequency FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND a.date BETWEEN 950101 AND 001231 ORDER BY a.account_id
